scriptLines: bronce derive(          RutaHistoricaId = iif(isNull(RutaHistoricaId) || trim(RutaHistoricaId) == '', toString(null()), iif(regexMatch(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), '^RH-'), upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), iif(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)) == 'R12-N', 'RH-12-N', iif(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)) == 'R12-S', 'RH-12-S', iif(lpad(replace(replace(replace(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'RUTA ', ''), 'R-', ''), ' ', ''), 2, '0') == '07', 'RH-07-OLD', iif(lpad(replace(replace(replace(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'RUTA ', ''), 'R-', ''), ' ', ''), 2, '0') == '12', 'RH-12-OLD', concat('RH-', lpad(replace(replace(replace(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'RUTA ', ''), 'R-', ''), ' ', ''), 2, '0')))))))),

VigenciaDesde = iif(isNull(VigenciaDesde) || trim(VigenciaDesde) == '', toDate(null()), iif(regexMatch(trim(VigenciaDesde), '^\\d{5}(\\.\\d+)?$'), addDays(toDate('1899-12-30'), toInteger(regexExtract(trim(VigenciaDesde), '(\\d+)', 1))), iif(instr(trim(VigenciaDesde), '/') > 0, toDate(left(trim(VigenciaDesde), 10), 'dd/MM/yyyy'), toDate(left(trim(VigenciaDesde), 10), 'yyyy-MM-dd')))),

limpiar filter(not(isNull(RutaHistoricaId)) && regexMatch(RutaHistoricaId, '^RH-') && CodigoRuta != '' && NombreRuta != '' && not(isNull(VigenciaDesde)) && not(isNull(VigenciaHasta)) && Estado != '') ~> validos
